behavior-ecosystem-v0.1.svg.generator: Hand-authored SVG committed with the page; moved from fipha unchanged apart from the package rename
behavior-ecosystem-v0.1.svg.source: No data; a boundary diagram of the observed-behaviour exchange types and the tools that produce them
behavior-ecosystem-v0.1.svg.claim: Pose estimators, state discovery and ethogram tools each retain their own semantics across a small typed boundary
behavior-ecosystem-v0.1.svg.published_target: Conceptual diagram; no published panel is claimed

cell2025-forecast.svg.source: Frozen Cell 2025 flagship benchmark using the checksum-pinned public behavioural table
cell2025-forecast.svg.estimand: Animal-balanced held-out choice log loss in the final five sessions
cell2025-forecast.svg.claim: Early behaviour improves forecasting over complete pooling, without uniquely selecting a trajectory mechanism
cell2025-forecast.svg.published_target: New prospective analysis; no published paper panel is claimed

cell2025-qvalue-response-time.svg.source: Checksum-pinned released Q-value summary and independently recomputed response-time summaries
cell2025-qvalue-response-time.svg.estimand: Released mean BIC by candidate and paired first-session versus final-five-session mean response time
cell2025-qvalue-response-time.svg.claim: The released model ranking and descriptive response-time reduction are separate retrospective evidence layers
cell2025-qvalue-response-time.svg.published_target: Cell 2025 first-five-day Q-value comparison and learning-related response-time result

cell2025-recovery.svg.source: Frozen exact-design simulations using Cell trial, contrast, session, subject, and fold geometry
cell2025-recovery.svg.claim: The prospective design resolves its main declared distinctions while retaining visible ambiguities
cell2025-recovery.svg.published_target: New design audit; no published paper panel is claimed

cell2025-strategy.svg.source: Checksum-pinned Cell 2025 public behavioural trial table and released continuous prop_below colour artifact
cell2025-strategy.svg.estimand: Pearson associations of days 4-8 bias with final-five-paper-day bias and right-minus-left psychometric slope
cell2025-strategy.svg.claim: Cell Figure 1G and 1I are independently recovered without treating either association as causal

cell2025-trajectories.svg.source: Checksum-pinned released Gaussian-process trajectories plus exact-stack Figure 1H/1J soft-DTW replay
cell2025-trajectories.svg.denominator: 30 animals, 100 released interpolation points per animal
cell2025-trajectories.svg.estimand: Right-minus-left psychometric slope over session and left-versus-right psychometric-slope paths
cell2025-trajectories.svg.claim: Cell Figure 1H/1J is replayed while the three soft-DTW centroids remain bounded retrospective summaries of continuous diversity

chen2021-bandit.svg.source: Checksum-pinned Chen et al. restless-bandit trials and frozen Behavio benchmark
chen2021-bandit.svg.denominator: 32 mice, 25279 trials, one session-8 forecast fold
chen2021-bandit.svg.estimand: Animal-balanced held-out log loss and exact-design WSLS/Q-learning recovery
chen2021-bandit.svg.claim: Reward-sensitive models forecast better than static accounts, while WSLS and Q-learning remain empirically unresolved
chen2021-bandit.svg.published_target: New prospective model comparison; the paper's sex-effect result is not reproduced

choice-model-evidence-atlas.svg.source: Deterministic representative fits and frozen dense four-family recovery benchmark
choice-model-evidence-atlas.svg.estimand: Observed behaviour, fitted structure, future prediction, calibration, and model-recovery score
choice-model-evidence-atlas.svg.claim: Different model families can share one evidential grammar without erasing family-specific structure

clock-boundary.svg.estimand: Conceptual comparison of clocks and training-only transform fitting
clock-boundary.svg.claim: Time coordinates and outcome-learned transforms must respect the validation boundary

ddm-recovery.svg.denominator: Declared repeats at two trial counts
ddm-recovery.svg.estimand: Parameter root-mean-square error by trial count
ddm-recovery.svg.claim: Recoverability changes with parameter and experimental information

diagnostic-layers.svg.estimand: Conceptual hierarchy of numerical, predictive, and recovery evidence
diagnostic-layers.svg.claim: Convergence, prediction, parameter recovery, and model recovery answer different questions

first-analysis.svg.estimand: Animal-level improvement in protected fifth-session log loss
first-analysis.svg.claim: The complete public-API workflow produces paired future-session evidence and a figure

hierarchical-pooling.svg.denominator: Declared subjects and between-subject variation grid
hierarchical-pooling.svg.estimand: Subject-coefficient RMSE and prospective log loss by pooling strategy

ibl-choice-response-time.svg.source: Checksum-pinned IBL sessions and frozen decision-model benchmark
ibl-choice-response-time.svg.unit: eligible trial from one outcome-blindly selected animal

ibl-choice-response-time.svg.claim: A contaminant component does not improve this animal's predeclared future-session score
ibl-choice-response-time.svg.published_target: New prospective diagnostic; no IBL paper panel is claimed

ibl-glmhmm-states.svg.source: Checksum-pinned IBL sessions and frozen GLM-HMM benchmark
ibl-glmhmm-states.svg.unit: eligible choice from one outcome-blindly selected animal
ibl-glmhmm-states.svg.estimand: Training-only state-count selection and untouched-session choice log loss

ibl-learning-trajectories.svg.source: Checksum-pinned IBL sessions selected by an outcome-blind endpoint rule

ibl-prospective-selection.svg.estimand: Training-only smoothness selection and paired untouched future-session log-loss difference

ibl-prospective-selection.svg.published_target: New prospective analysis; no IBL paper panel is claimed

interoperability-pipeline.svg.estimand: Conceptual mapping from data sources to one longitudinal study contract
interoperability-pipeline.svg.claim: Different adapters should converge before modelling and validation
